channel.title: Pier & Point · Edgewater
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Edgewater (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Edgewater: Edgewater's completion now shows the building permit's completed date of February 14, 2008. The Assessor's 2007 'year built' is a roll year, not a completion event; both are recorded.
item.description: Edgewater's completion now shows the building permit's completed date of February 14, 2008. The Assessor's 2007 'year built' is a roll year, not a completion event; both are recorded. Source: DataSF Building Permits i98e-djp9, permit 200502085025; DataSF Assessor Secured Roll wv5m-vpq2, parcel 8707003.

item.title: Correction · Edgewater: The map notes called Edgewater a condo complex made of many per-unit lots; 355 Berry is a single Assessor parcel classed as an apartment building, so those statements were corrected. The old note that year built and unit count were unconfirmed now cites the Assessor (2007, 193 units) and the permit (194 units). The summary no longer says 'rental', its location is attributed to the map and OSM, an earlier change entry now names permit #200502085025, and the Commons photo no longer says it was taken from a departing flight.
